  CASE WHEN product_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN product_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN category IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN discounted_price IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN actual_price IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN discount_percentage IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN rating IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN rating_count IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN about_product IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN user_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN user_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN review_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN review_title IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN review_content IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN img_link IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
  CASE WHEN product_link IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
) AS total_nulls
FROM data/amazon.csv
